# Synthetic V3B-1 public-bundle compatibility fixture

The sibling `v3b1-*` directory is deterministic synthetic compatibility
evidence generated by the test helper before the request-driver writer work.
It is not historical evidence and it is not a live run. Its sole purpose is to
freeze one complete `kil.v3b1-public-manifest.v1` presenter bundle for legacy
verifier acceptance tests.

KTP citation: [canonical `CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/nmcitra/ktp-rfc/blob/main/CITATION.cff).
